name: CJ Logistics - Elwood IL (Logistics Center 2 / NEXUS)

fieldNotes.location: EXACT BUILDING NOT POSITIVELY IDENTIFIED. Address confirmed via CJ Logistics' own open-space page: 21012 W. Mississippi Street, Elwood, IL (Elwood 2 / NEXUS). The roster geocode (GEOMETRIC_CENTER of CenterPoint Intermodal Center) landed inside the BNSF intermodal rail yard. This is a brand-new build-to-suit (ARCO/Murray, groundbreaking 10 Oct 2024, full ops H1 2026); current Maxar imagery of the CenterPoint corridor shows only established buildings - no distinct bare-earth construction pad could be matched to 21012 W Mississippi St, and the new building cannot be told apart from the dozens of similar CenterPoint warehouses. Coordinates and perimeter retained from the roster geocode are APPROXIMATE / UNRELIABLE.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Published spec (CJ open-space sheet / Business Wire): 130 dock positions, 120 fully equipped. 1,105,500 SF, 40 ft clear height, 6,500 SF office with driver area.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Inferred from CenterPoint Intermodal Center norm - all CJ/CenterPoint DCs in this park have fenced, guarded truck yards (confirmed at CJ Elwood LC1). Not verified for this specific building.

fieldNotes.railServed: Marketed as adjacent to BNSF and Union Pacific rail lines; CenterPoint Intermodal Center is rail-served. Whether a spur enters the building parcel is unverified.
